title: Three Summers and One Short Ditch
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：irrigation　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 irrigation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the grower ① dug the irrigation that no neighbour in the terrace would have recorded, and he said the digging was the whole of the week. The ② irrigation, meaning the water itself and not the ditch, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; irrigation, he said, is the only thing in a terrace that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of irrigation in that terrace had the same short ditch beside it, and the ④ irrigation at the far pump, meaning the channel they kept for the children to dig and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Irrigation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grower said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the irrigation was the whole of the matter, meaning the future and not the water. The ⑥ irrigation, meaning the future and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; irrigation, he said, is either something you dig or the only word that means both water and a future. He said the future is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ irrigation had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short ditch. The ⑧ irrigation of the whole thing, the grower wrote in June, was one terrace and three weeks of recording; irrigation, he said, is either the channel at the far pump or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ irrigation I remember is the irrigation recorded in the plan, which closed in 1978 and is still recorded as the quietest in the terrace. ⑩ Irrigation, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all irrigation, she said, is a future that has agreed to look like water. She said the future was the honest half.

irrigation 意为“灌溉；水利”，指那道灌溉水本身而不是水沟，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
irrigation 意为“灌溉；水利”，指梯田里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一条窄窄的水沟。
irrigation 意为“灌溉；水利”，指最远那台水泵留给孩子们挖的那一道那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
irrigation 意为“前景、指望”，指一件事里人人都浇却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份指望就是那件事的全部。
irrigation 意为“指望”，指人人都浇却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道灌溉水，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
irrigation 意为“灌溉；水利”，指图纸里写到、被记下的的那一道，到 1976 年这一道成了图纸里的一行。
irrigation 意为“水利之事”，种植人六月写道，整件事的灌溉之事是一处梯田和三个星期的记录。
irrigation 意为“灌溉；水利”，我记得的是图纸里记录过的那一道，1978 年通水了，至今仍被说成梯田里最安静的一道。
irrigation 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，灌溉是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的灌溉水。
